title: BOF Vault Intake Workbench
disclaimer: This workbench is a simulated intake review surface. BOF classifies, flags, routes, and records review outcomes; human review resolves uncertain or high-risk exceptions.

pipelineStages.label: Upload received
pipelineStages.description: Files arrive from drivers, fleet staff, partner carriers, email exports, or a structured intake bundle.

pipelineStages.label: OCR / file read
pipelineStages.description: BOF reads filenames, pages, visible fields, issue dates, expiration dates, and record identifiers.

pipelineStages.label: Document type classified
pipelineStages.description: Files are classified as CDL, medical card, MVR, insurance certificate, POD, settlement support, proof, or review-needed.

pipelineStages.label: Driver matched
pipelineStages.description: Documents are matched to a driver, carrier, equipment record, customer, or operating profile.

pipelineStages.label: Rules applied
pipelineStages.description: Driver, carrier, customer, equipment, proof, and contract-specific rules determine readiness impact.

pipelineStages.label: Exceptions generated
pipelineStages.description: Missing, expired, mismatched, duplicate, low-confidence, or conflicting records are routed to review.

pipelineStages.label: Human review queue
pipelineStages.description: Reviewers accept, request replacement, mark blocked, or assign uncertain items to the right owner.

pipelineStages.label: Readiness profile built
pipelineStages.description: BOF updates driver onboarding profiles, carrier readiness, proof packets, and audit history.

presets.label: Single Driver Onboarding
presets.summary: A new driver submits a CDL, medical card, application packet, and onboarding documents for first review.
presets.source: Driver mobile upload plus fleet admin email

documents.ruleImpact: Driver identity and CDL class confirmed for onboarding profile.
Medical certification is usable only after reviewer verifies the provider signature.
documents.reviewReason: Signature area is faint on the scan.

documents.ruleImpact: Payroll setup cannot be marked complete until missing W-9 page is returned.
documents.reviewReason: Packet is missing required tax setup page.
documents.requiredAction: Request replacement packet or missing W-9 page.

exceptions.impact: Payroll setup remains blocked until the W-9 page is returned.
Medical card is held for human review before readiness updates.

profiles.name: John Carter
profiles.nextAction: Verify medical-card signature and request missing W-9 page.

profiles.name: Darius Hill
profiles.nextAction: Attach profile to fleet readiness queue.

audit: Batch BVI-24018 staged from driver onboarding intake.

presets.label: Fleet Back-Office Bundle
presets.summary: A fleet uploads driver files, insurance certificates, settlement support, proof records, and onboarding packets.
presets.source: Fleet shared drive export and BOF intake mailbox

documents.ruleImpact: Medical card updates driver readiness and removes the expiring-document watch.
documents.reviewReason: Issuer, expiration, and driver match are clear.

documents.ruleImpact: CDL proof remains review-needed until the blurry scan is replaced.
documents.reviewReason: License number and expiration are partially unreadable.

documents.ruleImpact: Carrier insurance is usable for review, but customer-specific certificate holder wording needs confirmation.
documents.reviewReason: Certificate holder text differs from the customer packet requirement.
documents.requiredAction: Assign certificate wording to carrier packet reviewer.

documents.ruleImpact: POD can be attached to settlement and customer proof packet.
documents.reviewReason: Signed delivery record matched to load and driver.

exceptions.impact: Driver profile remains review-needed until replacement is uploaded.
Carrier packet can stay visible, but customer-specific wording must be confirmed.
Reviewer confirms which proof record should control the settlement packet.

profiles.name: Elena Lopez
profiles.nextAction: Move from watch to ready after medical card acceptance.

profiles.name: Marcus Reed
profiles.packet: Driver profile generated with CDL exception

104 files classified and matched to driver or carrier records.

presets.label: Aggregator Network Intake
presets.summary: A carrier network submits mixed carrier packets, driver files, insurance records, proof photos, and customer-specific rules.

documents.ruleImpact: Carrier packet meets Midwest Reefer Alliance onboarding rules.
documents.reviewReason: Authority, W-9, insurance, and contact sheet matched.
documents.requiredAction: Accept carrier packet and update network readiness.

documents.ruleImpact: Securement proof can be attached only after missing seal image is resolved.
documents.reviewReason: Photo set contains cargo brace images but no matching seal photo.
documents.requiredAction: Request missing seal photo or reviewer note.

documents.ruleImpact: Carrier packet remains blocked until current insurance certificate is received.
documents.reviewReason: Expiration date is in the past.

documents.ruleImpact: Proof packet can support settlement, invoicing, and post-trip review.
documents.reviewReason: Signed POD and lumper receipt matched to the same customer record.

exceptions.impact: Carrier remains blocked for customer readiness until current certificate is provided.
Securement proof needs a reviewer note or missing seal photo before packet completion.
Two carriers submitted similar driver names; reviewer chooses the correct affiliation.

profiles.name: Midwest Reefer Alliance
profiles.nextAction: Continue review of securement proof exceptions.

profiles.name: Sofia Ramirez
profiles.nextAction: Attach POD and lumper receipt to settlement support.

audit: Batch BVI-24077 received from aggregator partner intake bundle.
Carrier, driver, proof, and customer rule records classified separately.
Expired policy and missing proof exceptions routed to human review.

presets.label: Messy Bulk Cleanup
presets.summary: A mixed folder contains duplicates, wrong-driver files, expired certificates, unclear images, and proof records with missing pages.

documents.ruleImpact: Document cannot update any readiness profile until ownership is confirmed.
documents.reviewReason: Name is cropped and driver ID is missing.
documents.requiredAction: Assign to reviewer for owner match.

documents.ruleImpact: Driver readiness remains blocked until current MVR is received.
documents.reviewReason: MVR date is outside the accepted review window.

documents.ruleImpact: Reviewer confirms whether the newer file should supersede the current medical card.
documents.reviewReason: Duplicate file is newer than the existing record.

exceptions.impact: No readiness profile is updated until ownership is confirmed.
Driver is blocked from ready status until current MVR arrives.
Reviewer chooses which record controls the DQF profile.

audit: Batch BVI-24102 staged from unstructured email attachments.
Unmatched, expired, and duplicate files routed to review.
No uncertain document automatically updated readiness.
